dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This place is pretty high up, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Sugiyama
dialogues.text: I know, right? Someone needs to stand guard here at all times to advise people to watch their step — and so that no one will fall down unseen.

dialogues.speaker: Sugiyama
dialogues.text: This is one of the paths to Sangonomiya Shrine, after all, so no small number of shrine maidens, soldiers, and residents pass this way.

dialogues.speaker: Sugiyama
dialogues.text: ...Whatever the case, I just hope that the person taking over the shift gets here soon. I need to eat real bad...
